text: Ironvale Athletic effectively exploited their low block and deep defensive line to absorb Redmond Rovers' high press, using direct, vertical passing to launch quick counters that created multiple chances late in the match. Their tactical discipline limited Redmond’s pressing intensity (PPDA 3.8 vs. 6.2) and enabled four final third entries and shots in the last 8 minutes, culminating in Ilias Thorne’s equalizer at 86'. Redmond's high defensive line and quick circulation left exploitable spaces behind, which Ironvale capitalized on despite having less possession overall. Coaching point: Reinforce coordinated pressing triggers and deeper positioning transitions to reduce vulnerability to rapid vertical counters in late stages.
